objective: Measure and adopt selected specification practices inside the existing ecosystem

requirements.acceptance: Every new manual/automated task persists the new practice version; analyst templates default across providers; publication rejects missing or downgraded versions; resume preserves legacy tasks.
Missing data stays null, evidence and final commits are bound, providers and budgets split cohorts, snapshots precede process changes.
Specification, plan and task slices preserve existing requirements-analysis and implementation-plan contracts, stable SCN IDs and held scope.
Research-only idea assessment publishes evidence against, alternatives, evidence quality and a constrained decision without implementation or automatic delivery.
A versioned native plugin practice manifest pins its local skill assets and upstream provenance without adding a runtime.
Observe 3-5 comparable completed tasks per arm before claiming benefit; real product tasks must come from normal intake.

engineeringChecks.dependencyInjection: Not applicable: PowerShell artifact readers and Markdown templates; no service resolution changes.
engineeringChecks.dataAccess: Not applicable: existing task JSON/JSONL only, no database operations.
engineeringChecks.typeLayout: Not applicable: no declared classes, interfaces or enums are introduced.
engineeringChecks.disposableOwnership: ReadLines enumerators and repository writer helpers own file resources; no returned streams or MemoryStream.

delivery: User explicitly requested commit and push to main on 2026-10-21. Preserve both existing local commits.
